decisions.reason: ID Vault is a newly announced feature that fits KOBIL's core digital identity platform, and one year of results is too early to judge it against aspirations, so slack allows carrying it.
The identity-bound wallet is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with the wallet framework, so it is at some risk of consolidation, but it supports the firm's super-app strategy.

The NFC tag authenticator is a niche hardware-adjacent offering with weak visibility, which makes it the likeliest target for problemistic search, but its uncertain results do not yet clearly fall below aspiration.
The payment and wallet framework has a page of its own and is central to the firm's secure super-app business, so keeping it is consistent with its aspirations.
The multi-service mobile app platform is core to KOBIL's strategic direction and its established customer deals, so dropping it is unlikely.
App shielding is a long-standing core security competency with its own page, so it is a well-established product that will be kept.
